RUSTSEC-2026-0372 is an informational notice that zvariant_derive is unmaintained as a standalone crate, not a specific security vulnerability. uv includes it transitively through secret-service and zbus 5.15 for Linux keyring support. No patched standalone release exists; remediation requires an upstream dependency migration to zbus 6 and remains under evaluation.
